# Feature 3: soft delete for comments

Rules come from Okto Neuron, team vault, read 2026-10-30. No rule values are copied here. Read each value from the named source.

## Behaviour
- Deleting a comment keeps the row and marks it deleted. Source: policy-soft-delete.md (Neuron Q1).
- Deleted comments are left out of comment lists. Source: policy-soft-delete.md (Neuron Q1).
- Only the comment author may delete. Source: code-comment-ownership.md (Neuron Q1), and deleteComment in app/src/app/routes/article/article.service.ts.

## Data
- The deletion timestamp: its name and type are in policy-soft-delete.md. Add it as a nullable Comment column through a new Prisma migration.
- Comment fields today: code-comment-model.md and app/src/prisma/schema.prisma (Neuron Q3).

## Errors
- Error body shape for new errors: policy-error-response.md (Neuron Q2).
- Status codes: unchanged. Source: policy-error-response.md (Neuron Q2).

## Conflicts
1. Neuron Q3 disagrees with schema.prisma on one comment field. Followed the schema.
2. Neuron Q1 says delete removes the row today. The code hard-deletes in deleteComment. Followed policy-soft-delete.md, since this feature changes that.
3. Neuron Q2 lists fewer status codes in use than the code uses. Followed the unchanged-codes rule.

## Not covered by any rule
- A delete attempt by a non-author. deleteComment returns 404 because its lookup filters by author. Builder to confirm.

**Rules applied**

| Rule | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Delete keeps the row and marks it deleted | Set `deletedAt`; no row removed | `policy-soft-delete.md` (Neuron team vault, question 1) |
| Deleted comments leave comment lists | Filter `deletedAt: null` in the list query | `policy-soft-delete.md` (Neuron question 1) |
